- [RTIM.1.2] **The clock source is the only reader of host time whose value
  a rule can observe.** Every time the engine computes with — `now()`, fact
  timestamps, TTL and timer deadlines, the clock tick — must come from it, so
  putting the mock clock in its place ([RTIM.3.1.4]) puts every
  time-dependent decision under the harness's control. The one other reading
  of host time is a real-time tier's pump-WCET measurement, which no rule reads
  and which decides only the halt of [RTCT.7.3].
